title: ModelDiff
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool model diff <baseFile> <headFile>` (MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §5) — a STRUCTURAL diff of two models: it parses both into the model and compares structure, so a pure reformat is never reported. `changes` lists every field and rule that was added, removed, modified, or reordered between base and head, each with the per-aspect `deltas` that changed (a rule's condition/severity/code; a field's kind and per-kind config; a reorder carries a `position` before→after delta). For an ADDED element a delta carries only `after`; for REMOVED, only `before`; for MODIFIED/REORDERED, both. Element ids are field paths or rule full names.

changes.description: the element-level changes (fields and rules added/removed/modified/reordered/renamed/moved) — base order, then head-only additions

element.description: the element family that changed (computation/group are a later slice)

id.description: the element's path (field) or full name (rule)

change.description: how the element changed between base and head (REORDERED = same element, different position within its parent; RENAMED/MOVED = a removed+added pair re-labelled as the same element relocated — RENAMED keeps its parent, MOVED keeps its leaf name; `id` is the base path, the `path` delta carries the new path)

risk.description: the change's risk tier (the max over its reasons; loosening > tightening, since a loosened/removed rule silently accepts bad data)

riskReasons.description: the risk reason codes — a subset of the SPEC §5b taxonomy. HIGH (silently accepts bad data): RULE_REMOVED, POLARITY_INVERTED (a rule's condition was flipped to its logical complement — it now accepts what it used to reject; detected structurally from the two ASTs), KIND_CHANGED, SEVERITY_DOWNGRADED, CONSTRAINT_LOOSENED. MEDIUM (fails loudly / undetermined direction): RULE_ADDED, CONSTRAINT_TIGHTENED, STRUCTURE_ADDED/REMOVED, PATTERN_CHANGED, SEVERITY_CHANGED, SCALE_CHANGED, and — for a non-inverted condition change, classified from the ASTs — CONDITION_RESTRUCTURED (a clause was added/removed), REFERENCE_CHANGED (it reads different fields), OPERATOR_CHANGED (an operator swapped within the same shape), THRESHOLD_CHANGED (only a literal/threshold operand moved); CONDITION_CHANGED is the fallback when the condition can't be parsed for analysis. ELEMENT_MOVED (MEDIUM — a re-homing move, a removed+added pair with identical content in a different parent). LOW: CODE_CHANGED, METADATA_CHANGED, POSITION_CHANGED (a pure reorder — the element moved within its parent; display-order is semantic but not a validation loosening), ELEMENT_RENAMED (a content-preserving rename — a removed+added pair with identical content, same parent, new name).

partOfRefactor.description: present on a change folded into a refactor (the rename/move anchor, or a rewritten referrer) — the 0-based index into `refactors`; absent on a change that is not part of a refactor

deltas.description: the aspects that differ — every aspect for ADDED/REMOVED, only the differing ones for MODIFIED; a REORDERED element carries a single `position` delta (before/after = its 1-based index among its common siblings); a RENAMED/MOVED element carries a single `path` delta (before = base path, after = new path)

aspect.description: the aspect name (rule: condition/severity/code; field: kind/scale/min/max/minLength/maxLength/pattern; a reorder: position; a rename/move: path)

before.description: the base-side value (absent when the element is ADDED)

after.description: the head-side value (absent when the element is REMOVED)

conditionEdits.description: on a `condition` delta only — the LOCATED edit-script (MR1): WHICH clause/operand changed, a precise refinement over the coarse riskReason. And/Or chains are flattened and matched by content, so a clause inserted into a chain is one ADDED (a downstream clause is never mislocated) and a pure re-association is no edit; a genuinely ambiguous restructure degrades to the coarse kind for that region.

op.description: the node/subtree was added, removed, or replaced at this address

address.description: the breadcrumb of enclosing logic operators ("" at the root, "And", "And/Or") — stable under And/Or re-association, unlike raw left/right indices

nodeKind.description: the affected node's operator id ("?" for a degraded coarse region)

before.description: the base-side rendered subtree (absent for an ADDED clause)

after.description: the head-side rendered subtree (absent for a REMOVED clause)

summary.description: the human line (e.g. "threshold 1000→2000 on [Amount]", "added clause: FieldFilled(Approved)")

refactors.description: reference-rewriting refactors folded into ONE operation (MR4): each groups a rename/move with the referrers whose reference-delta is exactly that from→to repoint. A NON-DESTRUCTIVE overlay — the raw RENAMED/MOVED change and each rewritten referrer's MODIFIED change stay in `changes` (each carrying `partOfRefactor`), so the fold is verifiable from the change-set itself. Empty when the diff has no reference-rewriting refactor.

kind.description: RENAME (the element kept its parent, got a new name) or MOVE (it kept its leaf name, got a new parent)

referrers.description: the rules whose reference to `from` was rewritten to `to` (their raw MODIFIED changes remain in `changes`)
